# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
    }
    grid.segments(
        c(0, .5),
        c(.5, 0),
        c(1, .5),
        c(.5, 1),
        gp = gpar(lty = 3, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
    )
}
```

## Examples

### Horizontal Typesetting

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("The text is rendered horizontally by default.", y = .7)
grid.latex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。")
```

### Vertical Typesetting

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex(
    "The \\texttt{documentClass = 'utarticle'} parameter typesets text vertically.",
    width = unit(2.5, "in"),
    y = .9
)
grid.latex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", documentClass = "utarticle")
```

### Other Fonts

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("これはIPAフォントです。",
    documentClass = "utarticle", x = .1,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipa")
)
grid.latex("これはIPAexフォントです。",
    documentClass = "utarticle", x = .3,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipaex")
)
grid.latex("これはHaranoAjiフォントです。",
    documentClass = "utarticle", x = .5,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "haranoaji")
)
grid.latex("これはSourceHanフォントです。",
    documentClass = "utarticle", x = .7,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "sourcehan")
)
grid.latex("デフォルトのフォント。", documentClass = "utarticle", x = .9)
```

## Regression Checks

```{r, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("LuaTeX", engine = "LuaTeX", y = .7)
grid.latex("XeTeX", engine = "XeTeX", y = .3)
```
